In Episode 1 of our Bhutan Series, we explore the beautiful capital city of Thimphu, the heart of Bhutan.
We started our journey from the iconic Clock Tower Square, which is considered the center of Thimphu. Here, we met our guide Dorjee, who accompanied us throughout the Bhutan trip.
In Bhutan, having a guide is mandatory for tourists during the entire stay.
